title: Quis est homo
html_source: Latin: “Who is the man?” These are the opening words of the third stanza of the Stabat Mater. In Rossini’s setting, Quis est homo? is a duet for soprano and mezzo-soprano. His reference to Mercadante is puzzling.

anchor.prefix: ng cat. Like tearing silk. Tongue when she talks like the clapper of a bellows. They can't manage men's intervals. Gap in their voices too. Fill me. I'm warm, dark, open. Molly in
